# Lisbon 4-Day Budget Trip Plan

A practical 4-day Lisbon plan for **2 adults** from **2026-04-10 to 2026-04-13**, keeping the **total non-flight budget at €900**. This version assumes a **mid-budget, value-focused trip** with one affordable stay, public transit, casual meals, and a mix of free and low-cost sights.

## Best Neighborhoods, Daily Spend, and Trip Balance

| Day | Stay Area | Main Focus | Estimated Spend for 2 | Why it works |
|---|---|---:|---:|---|
| Apr 10 | Baixa or Chiado | Arrival, center walk, sunset viewpoint | €180–€220 | Central, easy first day, minimal transit |
| Apr 11 | Alfama or Graça | Historic Lisbon, tram, viewpoints | €190–€230 | Best for old-town exploring on foot |
| Apr 12 | Cais do Sodré or Santos | Riverfront, LX Factory, relaxed evening | €200–€240 | Good food access and nightlife without overspending |
| Apr 13 | Baixa or Avenida da Liberdade | Final sights, shopping, departure | €150–€190 | Convenient for baggage and airport access |

### Budget check for the full trip
- **Accommodation:** €450–€560 total
- **Food & drinks:** €220–€280 total
- **Local transport:** €40–€70 total
- **Activities & entry fees:** €80–€120 total
- **Buffer for extras:** €30–€60 total

## 4-Day Lisbon Itinerary

### Day 1: Central Lisbon Arrival and Easy First Walk
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg
- **Morning:** Arrive, check in, and keep the first half-day light. Stay in **Baixa** or **Chiado** so you can walk most places.
- **Afternoon:** Explore **Rossio Square**, **Rua Augusta**, and the **Santa Justa area** from outside; skip paid attractions unless you have energy.
- **Food:** Budget lunch at a café or tascas-style spot; dinner in Chiado/Baixa with simple grilled fish or bifana sandwiches.
- **Downtime:** End with a sunset drink or viewpoint stop near **Miradouro de São Pedro de Alcântara**.

### Day 2: Alfama, Castelo Views, and Classic Lisbon
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- **Morning:** Head to **Alfama** early for quiet streets, tiled facades, and photo stops.
- **Afternoon:** Visit **São Jorge Castle** if you want one paid highlight; otherwise focus on free viewpoints and the cathedral area.
- **Food:** Try a casual lunch of codfish, soup, or pastries; keep dinner simple in **Graça** or back in the center.
- **Downtime:** Take a slower late afternoon break in a café before an evening stroll.

### Day 3: Riverfront, LX Factory, and a Relaxed Evening
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/water.svg
- **Morning:** Start with the **riverfront** near **Cais do Sodré** and walk toward **Commerce Square**.
- **Afternoon:** Go to **LX Factory** for browsing, street art, and low-cost snacks; it is a good half-day with minimal planning.
- **Food:** Choose one nicer but still affordable dinner here, or split tapas-style plates to stay on budget.
- **Downtime:** Keep the evening open for a slow drink, a dessert stop, or early rest.

### Day 4: Easy Final Morning and Departure Buffer
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/house.svg
- **Morning:** Do a final neighborhood walk in **Baixa** or **Avenida da Liberdade** and pick up souvenirs only if prices feel fair.
- **Afternoon:** Leave a buffer for luggage, transit, and airport timing; avoid booking anything tight.
- **Food:** Simple brunch or bakery breakfast, then a light lunch before heading out.
- **Downtime:** Keep this day intentionally flexible so the trip ends calmly, not rushed.

## Recommended Stay Areas for Value and Convenience

- **Baixa:** Best overall balance for first-time visitors; central, walkable, easy transport.
- **Chiado:** Slightly pricier, but good for cafés, shopping, and a polished feel.
- **Alfama:** Scenic and atmospheric; better if you want old Lisbon charm and do not mind hills.
- **Graça:** Often better value than the center; local feel and great viewpoints.
- **Cais do Sodré / Santos:** Good for food, river access, and evening options.

## Low-Cost Activities Worth Prioritizing

- Walk **Baixa, Chiado, Alfama, and Graça** on foot
- Visit free viewpoints like **Miradouro de Santa Luzia** and **Miradouro de São Pedro de Alcântara**
- Ride a historic tram only once if you want the experience, not as daily transport
- Spend time at **LX Factory** for browsing and casual food
- Enjoy the **Tagus riverfront** at sunset
- Use bakeries, lunch specials, and simple tascas for meals instead of tourist-heavy restaurants

## Quick Actions
